_help: Edit me. rules are checked top to bottom and the first match wins; if none match, picks (or fallback candidates) decide. 'when' is one set of conditions (all must hold) or a list of sets (any set may hold). Placeholders in rule text: {STR} {DEX} {CON} {INT} {LCK} {total} {max} {fateTokens} {CLASS} {Class}.

rules.label: Highly skilled Champion
rules.reason: Blessed with an extraordinary total attribute sum of {total} and high proficiency in both mind, body, and fortune. You are a legendary hero chosen for greatness!

rules.label: Fortune's Fool
rules.verdictTag: WHOLLY WEAK ROLLS (PITY OF THE GODS)
rules.reason: With not a single attribute breaking past {max} (Total: {total}), every respectable guild shut their doors. You don the bells and motley—armed with sheer audacity, {fateTokens} Fate Rerolls, and ridiculous luck!

rules.label: Frontline Bruiser
rules.reason: Crushing physical power ({STR} Strength) and martial grit make heavy blades second nature. The front lines call your name.

rules.label: Sharp-minded Scholar
rules.reason: With an intellectual depth of {INT}, you manipulate the mystic weave effortlessly. Spellstaff and ancient grimoires answer your command.

rules.label: Hardy Pathfinder
rules.reason: A deadly pairing of {DEX} Dexterity with rugged endurance ({CON} CON) marks you as an apex wilderness scout and archer.

rules.label: Quick-fingered Opportunist
rules.reason: Lightning reflexes ({DEX} DEX) and sharp fortune ({LCK} Luck) grant you mastery over traps, shadows, and lethal backstabs.

rules.label: Stalwart Defender
rules.reason: Blessed with iron stamina ({CON} CON) and disciplined strength ({STR} STR), you bear consecrated plate as an anointed knight.

rules.label: Unshakeable Healer
rules.reason: Your stalwart constitution ({CON} CON) and spiritual poise make you an unyielding conduit for holy smites and restorative prayers.

fallback._help: Used when no rule matches. mode 'picks' uses the picks table below; mode 'candidates' uses the old highest-score tie-break (set it to confirm nothing else changed).
fallback.label: Well-rounded Adventurer
fallback.reason: With no clear class or calling, your character has been designated {Class} by fate. They are a well-rounded adventurer, ready to face any challenge that comes their way.

picks._help: Used when no rule matches. The highest stat is 'top'. Leave top, second or low blank to mean any; the most specific matching row wins, ties go to the earlier row. minTop (optional) means the top stat must be at least that. verdictTag and reason are optional per row; the defaults below fill in. Extra placeholders: {top} {second} {low} {topValue} {secondValue}.

defaults.label: Well-rounded Adventurer
defaults.reason: Led by {top} ({topValue}), with {second} close behind: {Class} by fate.

rows.label: Muscle over Mind
rows.reason: Heavy on muscle, light on thought: {STR} Strength carries you where {INT} Intelligence cannot.

races._help: The 15 kept dice (three per attribute) are added together; that total mod the number of races picks a row, so add or remove rows freely. Dropped dice do not affect race or character generation. nameStarts and nameEnds are joined at random to suggest a name.

rows.name: Human
rows.trait: Adaptable and ambitious. Learns any trade quickly.

rows.name: Elf
rows.trait: Long-lived and keen-eyed. Needs little sleep.

rows.name: Dwarf
rows.trait: Stout and stubborn. Reads stone like a book.

rows.name: Halfling
rows.trait: Small, lucky and hard to rattle.

rows.name: Gnome
rows.trait: Curious and inventive. Hums while working.

rows.name: Half-Orc
rows.trait: Fierce and enduring. Refuses to stay down.

rows.name: Tiefling
rows.trait: Marked by an infernal past. Unnerves crowds.

rows.name: Dragonborn
rows.trait: Scaled and proud. Carries a breath of ancestral fire.

display._help: Title shown on the calling screen. {race} {class} (lower case) {Class} (capitalised). Without a race the capitalised class is used. 'label' on a rule or pick row is the short snappy tag above the title. A rule with no 'class' is a tier: it supplies label and text, and the class comes from picks (add 'fateTokens' on it if it should override the class's).
